description: This file is a PHP test class using Codeception for API testing. It tests the creation of modules (e.g., Accounts) via REST API endpoints in SuiteCRM, including positive and negative test scenarios.

classes.name: CreateModuleCest
classes.description: Test class for creating modules via API for SuiteCRM V8, including methods for setup, successful creation, failure cases, and data providers.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method that logs in before each test.

methods.name: shouldWork
methods.description: Test that creating a module with valid data works appropriately, including optional ID handling.

methods.name: shouldNotWork
methods.description: Test that creating a module with invalid data or scenarios properly yields errors.

methods.name: shouldWorkDataProvider
methods.description: Provides datasets for successful creation test cases.

methods.name: shouldNotWorkDataProvider
methods.description: Provides datasets for failure creation test cases.
